topic: US and UK stage licensors and first published editions for the 30 plays in research-contemporary-plays.json

definitions.licensorUS: The company that licenses stage performance rights in the United States. Where the only evidence is a Dramatists Play Service or Samuel French acting edition, or Concord's UK page naming the US catalogue, the record says so in 'basis'. Records with 'evidence': 'search-result title only' are weak and should be verified.
definitions.licensorUK: A licensor whose own page offers UK performing rights: Concord Theatricals UK (concordtheatricals.co.uk /p/ licensing pages, quoting the catalogue line and fee) or Nick Hern Books (amateur rights). A Concord UK shop (/s/) page alone is not taken as licensing evidence.
definitions.firstPublished: The earliest edition found on a publisher page or a Google Books record. 'edition' is 'trade' for TCG, Faber, Nick Hern, Vintage, Little Brown, Northwestern; 'acting' for Dramatists Play Service and Samuel French. Where two editions share the earliest year, the note says which order was not established.
definitions.quotes: Quotes are the text returned by the fetch tool for the named page. Google Books quotes are the bibliographic table's 'Publisher' line; Concord UK quotes are the catalogue line beside the title.
definitions.catalogueOwnership: Concord Theatricals' UK homepage (https://www.concordtheatricals.co.uk/) lists 'The Dramatists Play Service Collection' and 'The Playscripts Collection' among its collections, so DPS titles are now handled through Concord. The date of that change was not verified (the Deadline report of May 2025 is behind a paywall redirect).

concordtheatricals.com (US) is refused to both WebFetch and WebSearch ('not accessible to our user agent'). dramatists.com, broadwaylicensing.com and playscripts.com all 301-redirect to concordtheatricals.com. faber.co.uk returned 403. Google Books in-book search hit Google's /sorry rate-limit page; googleapis.com/books returned 429 three times; worldcat.org returned 429 once and then a JavaScript shell; catalog.loc.gov redirects to a JavaScript search; catalogue.nla.gov.au is behind an Anubis bot challenge. concordtheatricals.co.uk (UK) and nickhernbooks.co.uk were readable.
